query:
SELECT s.id, s.companyName, u.email 
FROM sponsors s 
JOIN users u ON u.id = s.userId 
WHERE s.companyName IN ('Veremark', 'Wilson', 'Poetry', 'Udder')
ORDER BY s.companyName;
